name: SikaGrout-212 HP AU
paste:
SIKAGROUT®-212 HP AU: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaGrout®-212 HP AU, January 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/sikagrout-212-hpau.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaGrout®-212 HP AU where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaGrout®-212 HP AU is a cementitious, non-shrink, high performance grout that expands in two stages in both the plastic and hardened states (class A and C) to counteract the shrinkage normally associated with cement grouts.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. SikaGrout®-212 HP AU is used for flowable grouting applications.
1.4 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer - Typical applications may include.
    - Machine baseplates
    - Anchor bolts.
    - Bridge bearing pads and shear key grouting.
    - Pre-cast concrete sections.
    - Cavities, gaps and recesses.
    - High performance grouting.
1.5 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.12.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaGrout®-212 HP AU
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: DUAL SHRINKAGE COMPENSATED HIGH STRENGTH CEMENTITIOUS GROUT FOR APPLICATIONS FROM 10MM TO 100MM.
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer - Complies with the following Standards.
    - Classed as a non-shrink grout as per ASTM C1107.
    - Lab tested in accordance with AS 1478.2
    - Approved product by TMR Qld "Product index for Bridges" Repair Materials (Concrete)- Grouts Section 5.33 Feb 2019
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - ASTM C1107: cited elsewhere in the data sheet; listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports > Complies with the following Standards: (p.1); Features > Characteristics and advantages include: (p.1).
    - AS 1478.2: cited elsewhere in the data sheet; listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports > Complies with the following Standards: (p.1); Features > Characteristics and advantages include: (p.1).
    - AS 1478.2:2005: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Compressive strength (p.2).
    - ASTM C348: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Tensile strength (p.2).
    - ASTM C1090: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Technical Information > Expansion (p.2).
    - AS/NZS 2350.4: test method printed beside a stated value. Where: Application Information > Setting time (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer - Characteristics and advantages include.
    - Shrinkage compensating properties, classed as a nonshrink grout as per ASTM C1107.
    - High 28 day strengths.
    - Flowable consistency.
    - Adjustable consistency.
    - Formulated to not segregate or bleed.
    - Excellent impact and thermal resistance.
    - Non corrosive to steel or iron.
    - Lab tested in accordance with AS 1478.2
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Grey concrete in appearance
    - Density: 2200 kg/m3 approx. (dependent on water addition rate)
2.6 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Maximum grain size: Maximum aggregate size is 1mm for pumping.
2.7 Compressive strength.
    | Age | 23oC | 30oC |
    | 1 day | ~ 25 MPa | ~ 25 MPa |
    | 3 days | ~ 35 MPa | ~ 40 MPa |
    | 7 days | ~ 60 MPa | ~ 70 MPa |
    | 28 days | ~ 75 MPa | ~ 85 MPa |
    Test method printed: (AS 1478.2:2005)
    Note printed: Material and curing conditions at 230C / 50% r.h. The above results are based on 50mm x 50mm cube specimens (Flowable consistency)
2.8 Tensile strength.
    | 28 days | 12 MPa |
    Test method printed: (ASTM C348)
2.9 Expansion.
    | 1 day | 3 days | 14 days | 28 days |
    | 0.00% | 0.02% | 0.02% | 0.03% |
    Test method printed: (ASTM C1090)
2.10 Electrical resistivity.
    | 7 days | ~ 8,000 Ω.cm |
    | 28 days | ~ 11,000 Ω.cm |
    | 56 days | ~ 13,000 Ω.cm |
    | 90 days | ~ 14,000 Ω.cm |
    Test method printed: (FM5-578)
    Test method printed: 50mm Probe Spa-
    Test method printed: cing
2.11 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 20 kg bag
    - Shelf life: 9 months
    - Storage conditions: Store SikaGrout®-212 HP AU in dry conditions in unopened original packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment - Surface Prep.
    - Correct and thorough surface preparation is essential to achieve the high performance qualities of SikaGrout®-212 HP AU.
    - All surfaces must be clean, sound and free from dust, ice, oils, grease or other surface contaminants such as curing membranes and form release agent etc. Bolt holes and fixing pockets should be free of dirt and debris by air blasting. For maximum bond, surfaces should be abraded or roughened, preferably by mechanical means such as needle gun, grit blasting, grinding etc.
    - All prepared surfaces must be saturated with water several hours prior to grouting, ensuring it is free of any surface water or puddles.
3.3 Substrate quality / pre-treatment - Formwork.
    - The formwork used must be leak proof to allow for free flowing SikaGrout®-212 HP AU. The formwork should be arranged so that the grout head is maintained on the side above the level of the underside of the base plate. This will allow gravity flow to completely fill the void to be grouted.
    - Formwork should be coated with form oil to allow easy removal of forms. Ensure adequate air holes are provided.
3.4 Substrate quality / pre-treatment - Temperature Control. Temperature affects setting time and rate of increase for strength. For optimum performance maintain grout, concrete and/or steel substrates within the range of 18-25ºC prior to, during, and for 48 hours after placement of the grout.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (January 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Layer thickness: 10mm - 100mm
    - Pot Life: 30 minutes approx.
    - Flowability: ~40 Seconds; ~50 Seconds @30mins Tested at flowable consistency (Flow; Cone) (AS 1478.2:2005)
4.3 Mixing ratio.
    | Consistency | Water per 20kg bag (litre) |
    | Plastic | 2.8 L - 3.2 L |
    | Flowable | 3.3 L - 3.7 L |
4.4 Yield.
    | Plastic | Flowable |
    | Approx. yield per 20kg | 10.2 litres | 10.8 litres |
    | bag |
    | Approx. bags per 1m³ | 98 | 93 |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.5 Setting time.
    | Temp | Initial Set | Final Set |
    | Flowable | 23oC | ~ 5:00 | ~ 7:00 |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
    Test method printed: AS/NZS 2350.4
    Test method printed: Setting Time
    Test method printed: (hrs:mins)
4.6 Equipment.
    - SikaGrout®-212 HP AU must be mechanically mixed using a mechanical grout mixer or a suitable drum mixer. The grout mixer will reduce the chances of the mix becoming lumpy or aerated. Smaller quantities should be mixed in clean drum using an electric drill and spiral drill and spiral mixer at a speed of approximately 500 rpm.
    - DO NOT MIX BY HAND.
4.7 Mixing. 1. Plastic grout, add 2.8 L - 3.2 L of water per 20 kg bag. Flowable grout, add 3.3 L - 3.7 L of water per 20kg bag. 2. Add the powder component to approximately 70% of the total amount water component while mixing. 3. Add the remaining 30% of the water component to the grout at a steady rate while continuing to mix. 4. Mix until the grout appears homogenous (3-5 minutes). Allow to stand so any entrapped air can escape. Do not add more water to increase flow of the grout if a mix has stiffened due to time delays. If the grout is unworkable discard.
4.8 Application. SikaGrout®-212 HP AU can be placed by gravity flow or by pump. It is essential that proper placing on the job site is practised to ensure placement is completed without problems. Sufficient labour, grout and equipment must be present to ensure continuous placement.
4.9 Application - Gravity Flow.
    - Mixed grout should be poured one side of the void to avoid air entrapment. Grout is best poured over short distances to ensure this. Use a suitable header box, maintaining the grout head at all times to ensure continuous flow. To facilitate grout compaction and top plate contact, use rodding, tamping or flexible strapping in short strokes while maintaining an adequate head of grout. Do not vibrate as this will cause segregation. Any adjacent machinery or equipment causing vibration should be shut down until initial set (5 to 6hours).
    - Pumping
    - When pumping SikaGrout®-212 HP AU, ensure the pump is suitable for the grout consistency and for the distance and height it is to be pumped. A positive displacement pump is recommended. Place grout by pumping into the farthest corner, filling the space gradually. Ensure that air is not entrapped under the base plate.
4.10 Curing treatment. Suitable curing methods such as plastic sheet, wet hessian, curing compounds (eg, Sika Film for initial placement then Sika Antisol curing compoundsafter initial set) etc. must be used to protect the freshly applied grout from the drying effects of sun and wind. Curing must commence immediately after placement, and continue for at least 7 days. Curing is vital to the ultimate performance of grout as it allows optimum strength development and ensures tight contact with the baseplate.
4.11 Cleaning of equipment. Remove uncured SikaGrout®-212 HP AU from tools and equipment with water. Hardened material can only be removed mechanically.
4.12 Limitations and important considerations.
    - The strength values mentioned are the average values of laboratory test results. The results on the site may vary due to different environment,temperature, curing conditions, testing methods and cube sizes etc.
    - For detailed information on grouting application and guidelines, refer to Sika Grouting Method Statement.
    - Store SikaGrout®-212 HP AU in dry conditions in unopened original packaging.
    - Never apply to a dry substrate.
    - Trials should always be conducted when adding a recommended Sika Admxiture to SikaGrout®-212 HP AU to determine the optimum dosage rates under local conditions.
    - Sika Ferrogard-901 can be added to the mixing water (0.3 litres per 20kg bag) before mixing the grout to enhance protection of steel reinforcement.
    - For dry pack consistency use SikaGrout-GP.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Material temperature. Application Temperature between 5oC and 35oC
5.3 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.12):
    - The strength values mentioned are the average values of laboratory test results. The results on the site may vary due to different environment,temperature, curing conditions, testing methods and cube sizes etc.
5.4 Test methods printed beside stated values. Each value is as printed in the data sheet with its test method.
    - Compressive strength: Age | 23oC | 30oC; 1 day | ~ 25 MPa | ~ 25 MPa; 3 days | ~ 35 MPa | ~ 40 MPa; 7 days | ~ 60 MPa | ~ 70 MPa; 28 days | ~ 75 MPa | ~ 85 MPa (AS 1478.2:2005)
    - Tensile strength: 28 days | 12 MPa (ASTM C348)
    - Expansion: 1 day | 3 days | 14 days | 28 days; 0.00% | 0.02% | 0.02% | 0.03% (ASTM C1090)
    - Electrical resistivity: 7 days | ~ 8,000 Ω.cm; 28 days | ~ 11,000 Ω.cm; 56 days | ~ 13,000 Ω.cm; 90 days | ~ 14,000 Ω.cm (FM5-578) 50mm Probe Spa- cing
    - Flowability: ~40 Seconds; ~50 Seconds @30mins Tested at flowable consistency (Flow; Cone) (AS 1478.2:2005)
    - Setting time: Temp | Initial Set | Final Set; Flowable | 23oC | ~ 5:00 | ~ 7:00 AS/NZS 2350.4 Setting Time (hrs:mins)
5.5 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.6 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaGrout®-212 HP AU, January 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/9/sikagrout-212-hpau.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaGrout®-212 HP AU, version 20/11/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sds-sikagrout-212hpau.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: MSDS SikaGrout-212 HP AU GHS7, https://aus.sika.com/dms/getdocument.get/9cdba490-45ac-4c1d-b218-494f3ef1f9e7/MSDS%20SikaGrout-212%20HP%20AU%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
